items.value: The guy who does all the odd jobs around the school. Rumor is, he prefers to be paid in unmarked bills...
Oh, you got some cash for me, eh? You're alright, kid...
Tell ya what... I'll take care o' any 'problem' you got, especially since you gave me this much green chedda...
Consider it done. No need to worry your pretty little head...
That was almost too easy. Think I'll lay low for a bit...
They're sleepin' with the fishes now. Ain't no comin' back from that...
Piece o' cake. Maybe next time pick a real challenge...
